import copy,json,pathlib,subprocess
from src.tools.gpu_shared_claim import load_plan,write_immutable,validate_plan
p='configs/shared_test_priority_queue_01.json';sha='0830764a3954847c66a27862ffbe58d54bf093c0d726b128b8d04e1f16b19109'
full,original=load_plan(p,sha)
unit=next(u for u in full['units'] if u['name']=='gen_test_s16_round2_s02')
assert unit['budget_group']=='G01' and unit['timeout_seconds']==1600
trial=copy.deepcopy(full);trial['queue_id']='test_priority_first_unit_01';trial['units']=[unit]
trial['first_unit_gate']={'source_prepared_plan':original,'scope':'Exactly one original full scientific unit; no shortened grants or thresholds. Prepared all-unit plan is not submitted. After this unit ends and checks pass, the active common queue excludes this claimed unit and binds its real terminal proof.','maximum_business_units':1}
validate_plan(trial)
ref=write_immutable('configs/shared_test_priority_first_unit_01.json',trial)
print('FIRST_SHARED_TEST_UNIT_JSON: '+json.dumps({'plan_reference':ref,'unit_id':unit['unit_id'],'unit_name':unit['name'],'parent_timeout_seconds':1825,'pbs_walltime':'00:30:55','gpu_submission_performed':False},sort_keys=True))
